en.title: Memory Allocator — Aligned Alloc + Erase
en.description: Allocate the leftmost contiguous free block that starts at a boundary of 8 units; later, an entire block can be freed by its allocation ID.
en.input: n q; a line with n initial states of 0/1; then q lines: `0 x` requests x units, and `1 id` frees id. Indices start at 0; initially occupied units do not belong to any freeable allocation. Site supplement: n≤5000, q≤1000, x≥1.
en.output: Output one line per request: an allocation returns its starting index or -1; a free returns the number of freed units or -1.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the full approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: Process the operations one by one according to the definitions, and watch the boundaries.
